messages:
Micaela: quick sync — plan joint marketplace + on-prem hardware bundle for Snowflake connector and Milvus adapters. want packaging, runbook, and announcement timeline by EOY.

Samir: @Micaela ok. engineering needs final manifest by next Tue. clarify what 'on-prem bundle' includes — DGX image, HPE Apollo rpm, installer scripts? :thinking_face:

Jordan: marketplace teams need separate artifacts: AWS AMI, Azure managed offer, GCP marketplace container. i'll start AMI + ARM template drafts.

Anya: legal: require co-marketing agreement, logo usage, and an embargo clause. also check export control for preinstalled drivers in DGX images.

release-bot: checklist created: /releases/marketplace-dgx-milvus-bundle -> status: draft

Dev-Rel: i'll prepare two guides: cloud quickstart and on-prem install + troubleshooting. will capture screenshots and a short demo video.

Nate (sales): can we get 30/60/90 pilot SKUs for Dedicated + OnPrem? need ballpark utilization assumptions to price.

Engineering PM: action items recap:
- Samir: compile DGX/HPE default config + installer outline (due 1894080000)
- Jordan: AMI/ARM/GCP artifacts + marketplace test plan (due 1894150000)
- Dev-Rel: docs, quickstarts, demo video (due 1894210000)
- Anya: co-marketing + embargo clearance (due 1894280000)
- Nate: pilot SKUs and pricing bands (due 1894350000)

Samir: technical note — KV cache and batching behave differently on-prem. propose defaults: batch_size=8, max_latency_ms=100 for DGX. will open PR for Milvus schema mapper.

Micaela: marketing wants a 10-business-day embargo once partners sign off. proposed public date 2029-12-05. confirm ASAP.

Jordan: sample manifest i'll use for AMI tests (snippet):
```
{
  "name": "redwood-snow-milvus-dgx",
  "version": "0.9.0",
  "bundles": ["AMI","RPM","OCI"],
  "deps": ["nvidia-driver>=525","docker>=20.10"],
  "tests": ["snowflake-connection","milvus-e2e"]
}
```

Anya: partners asked for 2-week heads-up for joint blog + partner quotes. i'll coordinate approvals.

Dev-Rel: tagging @Samir for test vectors and @Jordan for AMI boot logs. will iterate in a smaller channel for install test runs.

Micaela: thanks everyone. next sync Tue 10am PT. ping me earlier if blockers. :thumbsup:
